extracted.summary: A solicitor is enquiring about a £32,000 litigation loan for a wife in divorce financial remedy proceedings where around £478,000 of property and pension assets are in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry regarding funding for your client's financial remedy proceedings. We have noted the £32,000 sought for counsel, a forensic accountant and your own costs, and the approximately £478,000 in assets in dispute. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction of the proceedings, the current stage and any listed hearing dates, a breakdown of the assets and any existing charges over them, your client's details and consent, and an estimate of costs to conclusion. We will send our criteria and application form separately. A member of the team will review the information once received and come back to you.
